# Hosted MCP tools

The tools of the hosted MeetStream MCP server (https://mcp.meetstream.ai/mcp, OAuth sign-in): 39 on in production, 1 off by default.

Sources: mcp 40 items 0eda25aa. Latest docs: https://docs.meetstream.ai/llms.txt (append `.md` to any page).

| Tool | What it does | Inputs (required in bold) |
|---|---|---|
| `cancel_scheduled_bot` | Cancel a bot scheduled for a future meeting so it never joins. | **bot_id** |
| `check_local_agent` | Coming soon (local agent, track 3d): test the bridge of a voice agent that uses model.provider local_agent (the dashboard's Test connection). | **agent_config_id** |
| `create_agent` | Create a voice agent (MIA) configuration, then send it with create_bot agent_config_id (never with the bridge sockets). | agent, **agent_name**, audio, **mode**, **model**, transcriber, voice, wake_word |
| `create_bot` | Send a MeetStream bot to a Zoom / Google Meet / Microsoft Teams meeting (or schedule it with join_at). | agent_config_id, bot_camera_stream_url, bot_image_url, bot_message, bot_name, callback_url, custom_attributes, google_login_domain, idempotency_key, join_at, language, live_audio_websocket_url, live_transcript_webhook_url, **meeting_link**, record_video, retention_hours, separate_audio_streams, separate_video_streams, sign_in_email, socket_connection_url, storage_id, strict_email, teams_login_domain, transcription_provider, video_layout, zoom_obf_url, zoom_use_own_app, zoom_zak_url |
| `delete_agent` | Permanently delete a voice agent (MIA) configuration. | **agent_config_id**, **confirm** |
| `delete_bot_data` | Permanently delete a bot's audio, video and transcripts. | **bot_id**, **confirm** |
| `disconnect_calendar` | Disconnect calendar accounts. | account_id, **confirm**, provider, purge_events |
| `get_agent` | One voice agent (MIA) configuration by id. | **agent_config_id** |
| `get_balance` | The prepaid MeetStream credit balance of this account, in USD (bots bill per hour from it). |  |
| `get_bot_detail` | Full session metadata: platform, duration, timings, status timeline, transcript_id (canonical source), caption_file (for meeting_captions provider), original request payload. | **bot_id** |
| `get_bot_status` | Current bot status. | **bot_id** |
| `get_bot_summary` | Deprecated: MeetStream has no built-in meeting summary, and this tool makes no API call. | **bot_id** |
| `get_chats` | Chat messages captured during the meeting. | **bot_id** |
| `get_media_urls` | Presigned S3 URLs for recorded media. | **bot_id**, kind |
| `get_participants` | Participants detected in the meeting (displayName, fullName, status, stream ids). | **bot_id** |
| `get_speaker_timeline` | Who spoke and when (chunk timeline with speaker ids/names). | **bot_id** |
| `get_stop_status` | Progress of a stop request (after remove_bot) without stopping the bot again: requested, acknowledged, stopped, force-stopped or failed. | **bot_id** |
| `get_transcript` | Fetch a bot's transcript by bot_id. | **bot_id**, raw, timeout_seconds, wait |
| `list_agents` | List the voice agent (MIA) configurations of this account, and mia_managed: whether MeetStream's inbuilt keys are on (enabled) and the providers and models they cover per section. |  |
| `list_bots` | List all bots on the account (paginated: bots[], hasNextPage, nextCursor). |  |
| `list_calendar_connections` | The Google and Outlook calendar accounts connected for calendar bots, with the status of each. | cursor, limit |
| `list_calendar_events` | Upcoming events from the Google Calendars connected to this MeetStream account. |  |
| `list_scheduled_bots` | Bots with a future join time: join_at bots and calendar-scheduled bots. | limit |
| `list_transcriptions` | All transcription runs for a bot: transcript_id, provider, status, presigned download_urls (valid 1h). | **bot_id** |
| `lower_hand` | Lower the bot's hand in a live meeting. | **bot_id** |
| `pause_recording` | Pause capture for a bot in a Google Meet, Zoom or Teams meeting. | **bot_id** |
| `raise_hand` | Raise the bot's hand in a live meeting, for example so an agent waits its turn before it speaks. | **bot_id** |
| `remove_bot` | Make the bot leave an active meeting now. | **bot_id** |
| `reschedule_bot` | Change the join time of a bot that is already scheduled (join_at or calendar), instead of cancelling it and creating a new one. | **bot_id**, **scheduled_join_time** |
| `resume_recording` | Resume capture for a paused bot. | **bot_id** |
| `schedule_calendar_bot` | action=schedule sends a bot to a specific calendar event; action=unschedule removes it. | action, **event_id** |
| `send_chat_message` | Post a chat message into the live meeting through the bot. | **bot_id**, **message** |
| `send_image` | Display an image/GIF as the bot's video frame. | **bot_id**, display_duration_seconds, **img_url** |
| `take_screenshot` | Capture the meeting from a bot that is in it (send_command screenshot). | **bot_id** |
| `top_up_link` | Link to the MeetStream dashboard billing page, where the account owner adds prepaid credits. |  |
| `transcribe_audio` | Start a (re-)transcription of a bot's recorded audio with a chosen post-call provider. | **bot_id**, callback_url, language, provider |
| `update_agent` | Change a saved voice agent (MIA) configuration. | agent, **agent_config_id**, agent_name, audio, mode, model, transcriber, voice |
| `update_live_agent` | Change a running MIA voice agent mid-call (a bot created with agent_config_id): its prompt variables, system prompt or wake words. | agent_config_params, **bot_id**, system_prompt, wait_for_ack, wake_word_enabled, wake_words |
| `wait_for_meeting_event` | Live meeting events for a bot this key created with live events on: chat messages, joins and leaves, as the bot sees them during the call. (off by default; the server enables it with its live-events setting) | after_seq, **bot_id**, kinds, timeout_seconds |
| `webhook_events_guide` | Reference for MeetStream webhook events: envelope shape (event and bot_event), the two-layer bot.stopped terminal model, status codes, and streaming-provider caveats. |  |
